python_interfaces.name: ConnectionFactory
python_interfaces.rule: all returned connections are already safety-configured/verified; callers never apply their own alternate connection policy

python_interfaces.name: UnitOfWork
python_interfaces.rule: begins BEGIN IMMEDIATE once; repositories share this exact connection; implicit nested UoW is forbidden

python_interfaces.name: ReadSnapshot
python_interfaces.rule: short read-only consistent snapshot; no writes/operator waiting

python_interfaces.name: MigrationStatusReader
python_interfaces.rule: strict observational semantics; never routes through mutating connection factory

python_interfaces.name: AuditWriter
python_interfaces.rule: no internal commit; plain insert only; payload validation occurs before persistence

python_interfaces.name: JobStore
python_interfaces.rule: every mutation uses short foundation UoW

python_interfaces.name: HostRuntime
python_interfaces.rule: web framework remains behind this adapter; domain modules do not import uvicorn/starlette runtime objects

python_interfaces.name: RunSecurityProvider
python_interfaces.rule: LLD-01 consumes this interface and never stores raw security material in domain/foundation audit or diagnostics

repository_contract: repositories return domain/foundation value objects, never sqlite3.Row
repositories do not call external services or wait
SQL names are static code; values are always bound parameters
application_boundary_contract: transport parses bounded request -> application command value object
stable error category crosses transport; raw database exception does not
